protocol: jevkit CLI per arm (--public, declared price); paired stratified bootstrap B=1000 seed 16 (strata of the baseline table), Speed/Cost held fixed; tol 0.05

holm.rule: Holm step-down on one-sided bootstrap p (P(delta <= 0)); an in-job arm is claimable iff p < its level AND its two-sided CI at 1 - level excludes 0 on the positive side

h2o.caveat: cross-job: the target's S comes from its own job / hardware run and K from its own declared price; only I and C are paired on the same items

screen_price.source: JevBench v1.6.1 board api_v161.json deepinfra:Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B 0.03/0.15 per 1M (the price basis of the h2o-lightning-4b row; EV-PREREG-H2O-HOST)

native.rule: G1 PASS iff every op n>0, 0 invalid, 0 flips, max|dp| <= bound (0 = bitwise), on-disk rows in the in-memory order and really reordered / relabelled

stock_shim.rule: G1 PASS iff every op n>0, 0 invalid, 0 flips, max|dp| <= bound (0 = bitwise), on-disk rows in the in-memory order and really reordered / relabelled
